headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Rust Integration
summary: By integrating Rust, ClearInstall can offer more robust and secure dependency management. Leveraging Rust's safety features will reduce potential vulnerabilities in the lockfile audit process.
actions: Integrate Rust-Anything for enhanced dependency parsing and validation to ensure all dependencies are correctly identified and audited.
Use Rust libraries for improved performance in analyzing binding.gyp files, ensuring faster and more accurate command expansion checks.
Implement Rust-based security audits as part of the install-surface checker to detect potential risks early in the development lifecycle.
